title: Tarbell Foundation Allots $10M to AI Journalism With First Grant to NPR
summary:
Kevin Roose and Casey Newton will receive $480,000 to launch a new podcast, Machine Gods, which will cover the development and impact of artificial intelligence.

The funding is part of a $10 million initiative by the Tarbell Foundation to support AI-focused reporting over the next 12 months. NPR's reporting team, which monitors how technology influences politics, will also receive $250,000 as part of the first round of grants from the fund.
